_doc: Recorded by 412-ui-no-new-tab from a jar that still had the New category: every leaf tab under New (class -> path) and the tooltip each row showed there (owner sub-tab -> label key -> tooltip). Variant legit. Edited 2026-10-08 (mod inv-batch, killer560's request): Armor Recolour became Custom Items (tab, rows and tooltips replaced), Cosmetics became Player Cosmetics, and the Inventory Sorter's master tooltip changed with the rebuilt feature.

(unscoped).ability cooldowns: Detects the abilities you use and counts down their real cooldowns.
(unscoped).ability keybinds: Custom keys for your dungeon class Ability and Ultimate.
(unscoped).ability timers: Bound keys start countdowns, and running timers show on the Ability Timers HUD.
(unscoped).custom items: Recolours and reskins items on your screen only; nothing is sent to the server.
(unscoped).arrow align: Shows how many clicks each Arrow Align frame still needs and can block clicks that overshoot.
(unscoped).auto kick: Warns or kicks when your run takes longer than the target time set for its floor.
(unscoped).blessings: Shows your five dungeon blessing levels on a HUD and can announce each level up.
(unscoped).blood camp: Tracks the Watcher's blood mobs and predicts where each will land.
(unscoped).chat keybinds: Keys or mouse buttons that send a command or chat message you set.
(unscoped).chunk cache: Keeps chunks you've loaded readable in memory so the map, waypoints and solvers still see rooms you left.
(unscoped).class colors: Colors dungeon teammates by their class in the tab list and on nametags.
(unscoped).croesus / chest profit: Shows what each dungeon reward chest is worth, logs your claims, and (cheat build) claims the best chest.
(unscoped).custom mage beam: In dungeons, redraws every Mage beam as one clean coloured line.
(unscoped).custom scoreboard: Replaces the sidebar with a custom styled scoreboard.
(unscoped).door keys: Outlines dropped Wither and Blood Keys in dungeon rooms.
(unscoped).dungeon map: Draws the real dungeon map as a HUD overlay, showing only what your hotbar map has revealed.
(unscoped).enchant colours: Recolours enchantment names in Hypixel item lore by tier, like SkyHanni.
(unscoped).fairy souls: Tracks which Fairy Souls you have found and guides you to the missing ones.
(unscoped).inventory hud: Shows your main inventory as a HUD panel.
(unscoped).inventory search: Press Ctrl+F in any inventory to search; matching items get a red outline.
(unscoped).item browser: Shows a panel listing every Skyblock item beside your inventory.
(unscoped).item protection: Turns on the guards that stop you losing your own gear.
(unscoped).leap counter: Counts how many teammates leap to you in F7/M7 Phase 3 and alerts when all have arrived.
(unscoped).loadout keybinds: Lets keys click loadout slots and change pages on the Loadout screen.
(unscoped).maxor's crystals: Phase 1 crystal helpers: timers, an unplaced-crystal warning, a counter and crystal boxes.
(unscoped).mod chat: Run /killer560 chat <message> to send a tagged message other mod users see as an overlay.
(unscoped).p3 nav: Phase 3 navigation: boxes the next section gate and the terminals and devices you have left.
(unscoped).p4 platform highlight: F7/M7 only: boxes the platform you mine through to reach Necron.
(unscoped).performance hud: Shows TPS, ping, FPS and a click counter in one movable HUD element.
(unscoped).profile viewer: Run /pv <name> to open any player's Skyblock profile in game.
(unscoped).quiver display: Shows how many arrows you have left in a HUD line.
(unscoped).rag axe: Ragnarock Axe helper with cast detection, timers and rag now prompts.
(unscoped).revert master stars: Turns the Master Star number on item names back into that many red stars.
(unscoped).run stats: Prints a per-player summary in chat after each dungeon run: rooms cleared, secrets and deaths.
(unscoped).run summary: Records a summary of each finished dungeon run (splits, secrets, deaths, score) that you can reopen later.
(unscoped).score calculator: Shows a live estimate of your dungeon score on a movable HUD.
(unscoped).scrollable tooltips: Lets the mouse wheel scroll or nudge an item tooltip in inventories and menus.
(unscoped).secrets hud: Shows secrets found in your current room out of its total.
(unscoped).slot binds: Links two inventory slots so shift-clicking one swaps them.
(unscoped).split timers: Shows a HUD timing each part of a dungeon run.
(unscoped).starred mob hitboxes: Boxes starred mobs and secret bats, and highlights the F7/M7 wither boss.
(unscoped).storage search: Searches your cached Ender Chests and Backpacks from one screen; also opens with /k560search.
(unscoped).teammate highlight: Draws a box around each party member, coloured by their dungeon class.
(unscoped).terminal timers: Shows terminal solve times and section splits in your own chat during F7/M7 P3.
(unscoped).terracotta timer: Shows a respawn countdown over each broken terracotta in the F6/M6 boss.
(unscoped).thorn (f4): Helpers for the F4/M4 boss Thorn: Spirit Bear kill counter, highlights and stun-spot waypoints.
(unscoped).tick timers: Shows a countdown HUD for the F7/M7 boss phases.
(unscoped).trajectories: Draws the flight path and landing spot of your bow shot or Ender Pearl.
(unscoped).waypoint routes: Shows ordered waypoint routes for the current Skyblock area.
(unscoped).wither dragons: Tracks the five M7 Phase 5 dragons with spawn timers, health and which one your class should take.

Ability Cooldowns.ability cooldowns: Detects the abilities you use and counts down their real cooldowns.

Ability Keybinds.ability keybinds: Custom keys for your dungeon class Ability and Ultimate.

Ability Timers.+ add timer: Adds a new countdown timer to the list.
Ability Timers.ability timers: Bound keys start countdowns, and running timers show on the Ability Timers HUD.
Ability Timers.color: Colour of this timer's line on the Ability Timers HUD.
Ability Timers.delete: Removes this entry from the list.
Ability Timers.duration: How long the countdown runs once started.
Ability Timers.enabled: Turns just this one timer on or off.
Ability Timers.key: Press this key when you use the real ability to start or restart the countdown.
Ability Timers.name: What this timer is called on the HUD, e.g. Bonzo Mask.
Ability Timers.test start: Starts this timer now so you can see it on the HUD.

Advanced Position.advanced position: Shows your exact X, Y and Z as a small movable HUD.

Architect's First Draft.click message on puzzle fail: Posts a clickable chat line to get an Architect's First Draft from your sack when a puzzle fails.

Custom Items.custom items: Recolours and reskins items on your screen only; nothing is sent to the server.
Custom Items.open custom items: Opens the Custom Items menu (/customitems): pick an item, then set its colour, skin or look.
Custom Items.reset all: Removes every saved look; press twice.

Arrow Align.prevent misclicks: Blocks right-clicks on an Arrow Align frame that already points the right way.
Arrow Align.solve time: Posts how long Arrow Align took in chat when you finish.
Arrow Align.solver: Shows the solution for this puzzle or device.

Auction House.auction house browser: Turns on the custom Auction House browser, opened with /killer560 ah or a keybind.

Auto Kick.auto kick: Warns or kicks when your run takes longer than the target time set for its floor.

Bazaar.bazaar browser: Turns on the custom Bazaar browser, opened with /killer560bz or a keybind. Like Hypixel's remote Bazaar, it only opens while your Booster Cookie is active.

Best Friends.party time tracker: Tracks time partied and dungeon runs cleared with each player; open it with /bestfriends.

Blessings.blessings hud: Draws one line per blessing you have picked up while inside a dungeon.
Blessings.colors: Text colour of each blessing's HUD line.
Blessings.life color: Colour of the Life line on the Blessings HUD.
Blessings.power color: Colour of the Power line on the Blessings HUD.
Blessings.roman numerals: Writes blessing levels as V instead of 5.
Blessings.shown blessings: Which blessings may appear on the HUD.
Blessings.stone color: Colour of the Stone line on the Blessings HUD.
Blessings.time color: Colour of the Time line on the Blessings HUD.
Blessings.wisdom color: Colour of the Wisdom line on the Blessings HUD.

Blood Camp.blood camp: Tracks the Watcher's blood mobs and predicts where each will land.

Chat Keybinds.chat keybinds: Keys or mouse buttons that send a command or chat message you set.

Chunk Cache.chunk cache: Keeps chunks you've loaded readable in memory so the map, waypoints and solvers still see rooms you left.
Chunk Cache.clear cache: Throws away every chunk cached for the current world.
Chunk Cache.max cached chunks: How many chunks to keep in memory, 500-20000.
Chunk Cache.memory: How much of the chunk cache may stay in RAM.

Class Colors.class colors: Colors dungeon teammates by their class in the tab list and on nametags.

Command Shortcuts.basic: Adds a shortcut that queues the Basic Kuudra tier.
Command Shortcuts.burning: Adds a shortcut that queues the Burning Kuudra tier.
Command Shortcuts.command shortcuts: Turns on every Catacombs, Master Mode and Kuudra command shortcut below.
Command Shortcuts.f0: Adds /f0 to queue the Catacombs entrance.
Command Shortcuts.f1 & m1: Adds /f1 and /m1 to queue Catacombs floor 1 and Master Mode floor 1.
Command Shortcuts.f2 & m2: Adds /f2 and /m2 to queue Catacombs floor 2 and Master Mode floor 2.
Command Shortcuts.f3 & m3: Adds /f3 and /m3 to queue Catacombs floor 3 and Master Mode floor 3.
Command Shortcuts.f4 & m4: Adds /f4 and /m4 to queue Catacombs floor 4 and Master Mode floor 4.
Command Shortcuts.f5 & m5: Adds /f5 and /m5 to queue Catacombs floor 5 and Master Mode floor 5.
Command Shortcuts.f6 & m6: Adds /f6 and /m6 to queue Catacombs floor 6 and Master Mode floor 6.
Command Shortcuts.f7 & m7: Adds /f7 and /m7 to queue Catacombs floor 7 and Master Mode floor 7.
Command Shortcuts.fiery: Adds a shortcut that queues the Fiery Kuudra tier.
Command Shortcuts.hot: Adds a shortcut that queues the Hot Kuudra tier.
Command Shortcuts.infernal: Adds a shortcut that queues the Infernal Kuudra tier.

Player Cosmetics.copy settings for global cosmetics: Copies your name and scale to your clipboard so staff can apply them for you.
Player Cosmetics.custom names: Opens the Name Changer: your own display name, its colours, and renames for other players.
Player Cosmetics.height: Stretches your own player model up and down (0.5x-2x), in your own F5 view only.
Player Cosmetics.held item: Opens Held Item Transform: the size, position and rotation of your first-person held item.
Player Cosmetics.my size: Your own player model's size (0.05x-2x); shared with other supporters while Share if Supporter is on.
Player Cosmetics.others' size: Resizes every other player's model on your screen (0.05x-2x); never shared.
Player Cosmetics.player size: Opens the player size settings: your own size, everyone else's, and your model's shape.
Player Cosmetics.reset: Puts the size slider beside it back to 1.00x.
Player Cosmetics.reset cosmetics: Puts your display name, colours, fade, both player sizes and model shape back to default.
Player Cosmetics.share if supporter: Automatically shares your display name and your own player size with other players who have this mod.
Player Cosmetics.thickness: Stretches your own player model front to back (0.5x-2x), in your own F5 view only.
Player Cosmetics.width: Stretches your own player model side to side (0.5x-2x), in your own F5 view only.

Croesus / Chest Profit.chat summary: Posts a chat line with the profit and totals after each logged claim.
Croesus / Chest Profit.chest profit: Shows value, cost and profit next to dungeon reward chests and in Croesus.
Croesus / Chest Profit.croesus profit logger: Logs every chest you claim and keeps session and all-time profit totals.
Croesus / Chest Profit.highlight best: Highlights the most profitable unopened chest in green in Croesus.
Croesus / Chest Profit.highlight runs: Outlines Croesus runs green if unclaimed and red if already claimed.
Croesus / Chest Profit.include essence: Counts essence rewards toward a chest's value.
Croesus / Chest Profit.open profit tracker: Opens the /croesus tracker with your profit totals and big drops.
Croesus / Chest Profit.second best with key: Also highlights the second-best chest if it still profits after paying for a Chest Key.

Custom Mage Beam.custom mage beam: In dungeons, redraws every Mage beam as one clean coloured line.

Custom Scoreboard.custom scoreboard: Replaces the sidebar with a custom styled scoreboard.

Door Keys.door keys: Outlines dropped Wither and Blood Keys in dungeon rooms.

Dungeon Alerts.room alerts: Plays a sound when a dungeon room is cleared or all its secrets are found.
Dungeon Alerts.shadow assassin alert: Shows a title and plays a sound when a Shadow Assassin teleports behind you.

Dungeon Map.border colour: Outline colour around the HUD map; set alpha to 0 for no border.
Dungeon Map.checkmark sprites: Draws the real map's check, cross and question mark instead of text characters.
Dungeon Map.colour rooms by type: Paints each room its real colour by type; off uses the Normal colour for every room.
Dungeon Map.darken unexplored: How much dimmer rooms you have not opened are drawn, 0 to 0.9.
Dungeon Map.dungeon map: Draws the real dungeon map as a HUD overlay, showing only what your hotbar map has revealed.
Dungeon Map.extra info overlay: Shows score, secrets for S+, crypts, deaths and bonus kills under the Dungeon Map. Works with Score Calculator off.
Dungeon Map.font scale: Size of the text drawn on the Interactive Map, 0.5x to 3x.
Dungeon Map.funny map: Placeholder: saved, but does nothing yet (needs map pixel data first).
Dungeon Map.icon scale: Size of the player markers on the Interactive Map, 0.5x to 3x.
Dungeon Map.map background: Colour behind the map; the alpha slider sets how see-through it is.
Dungeon Map.mimic room show/hide: Placeholder: saved, but does nothing yet (needs map pixel data first).
Dungeon Map.player-head class recolor: Placeholder: saved, but does nothing yet (needs map pixel data first).
Dungeon Map.reset room colours: Puts every room and door colour back to the real dungeon map's colours.
Dungeon Map.room colours: Shows a colour picker for every room and door type.
Dungeon Map.text shadow: Draws a drop shadow behind the text.

Dungeon Queue.auto requeue: Sends /instancerequeue automatically when a dungeon run ends.
Dungeon Queue.party finder overlay: Adds join highlights, member counts and player stats to the Party Finder.

Enchant Colours.enchant colours: Recolours enchantment names in Hypixel item lore by tier, like SkyHanni.

F7 Spots.add aim spot here: Saves the point your crosshair is on as an aim spot.
F7 Spots.add waypoint here: Saves the block you're standing on as a waypoint.
F7 Spots.aim spot color: Colour of the aim-spot crosshair markers.
F7 Spots.aim spot distance: Shows the distance to each aim spot in its label.
F7 Spots.aim spot labels: Shows each aim spot's name next to its marker.
F7 Spots.aim spot size: Size of the aim-spot crosshair marker, 0.1-2.0 blocks.
F7 Spots.aim spots: Draws crosshair markers at your saved Last Breath aim spots; press Add Aim Spot Here to save one.
F7 Spots.arrow stack spots: Adds NoammAddons' arrow-stack aim points for the five P5 dragons (needs Aim Spots on).
F7 Spots.current phase only: Only shows waypoints for the boss phase you're in.
F7 Spots.devonian lb spots: Adds Devonian's five Last Breath spots for the P5 dragons (needs Aim Spots on).
F7 Spots.last breath aim spots: Shows saved aim points for Last Breath, based on your class.
F7 Spots.new aim class: Which class the next added aim spot is tagged for; Auto uses your class.
F7 Spots.new aim situation: Which dragon or phase the next added aim spot is tagged with; Auto uses where you are.
F7 Spots.new waypoint floor: Which floor the next added waypoint is tagged with; Auto uses your current floor.
F7 Spots.new waypoint phase: Which phase the next added waypoint is tagged with; Auto uses your current phase.
F7 Spots.remove last aim spot: Deletes the most recently added aim spot.
F7 Spots.remove last waypoint: Deletes the most recently added waypoint.
F7 Spots.show all classes: Shows every aim spot instead of only the ones for your class.
F7 Spots.show all situations: Shows every aim spot whatever phase or dragon it is for.
F7 Spots.walk waypoints: Draws your saved F7/M7 walk-to spots in the boss arena; press Add Waypoint Here to save one.
F7 Spots.walk-to waypoints: Draws your saved standing spots for F7/M7 in the world.
F7 Spots.waypoint beam: Height of the light column above each waypoint, 0-40; 0 turns it off.
F7 Spots.waypoint color: Colour of walk-to waypoints that have no colour of their own.
F7 Spots.waypoint distance: Shows the distance to each waypoint in its label.
F7 Spots.waypoint labels: Shows each waypoint's name above its box.

Fairy Souls.pathfinding: Shows the fastest walking route to anywhere on the island.

Friends List.use our /fl: Makes /fl open this mod's Friends List instead of Hypixel's; /flhypixel still opens Hypixel's.

Held Item Transform.held item transform: Resizes, moves and rotates your held item in first person.

Inventory HUD.inventory hud: Shows your main inventory as a HUD panel.

Inventory Search.inventory search: Press Ctrl+F in any inventory to search; matching items get a red outline.

Inventory Theme.hide potion effects: Hides the potion effects panel beside the inventory and chest screens.
Inventory Theme.inventory theme: Re-skins the chest and inventory screens, and the hotbar, in this mod's look.

Item Browser.item browser: Shows a panel listing every Skyblock item beside your inventory.

Item Protection.item protection: Turns on the guards that stop you losing your own gear.

Leap Counter.alert: What happens when the expected number of teammates have leaped to you.
Leap Counter.alert text (& colour codes): The title text; & colour codes work.
Leap Counter.core leaps: Teammates expected to leap to you once inside the core. 0 turns it off.
Leap Counter.counter hud: Shows how many teammates have leaped to you, like 1/4.
Leap Counter.detection: Counts a teammate as leaping to you when they cover the Jump Distance quickly and land within the Leap Radius.
Leap Counter.expected leaps: How many teammates should leap to you in each Phase 3 section.
Leap Counter.jump distance: Blocks a teammate must travel quickly for the arrival to count as a leap (3-20).
Leap Counter.leap alert sound: Plays a sound with the title.
Leap Counter.leap alert title: Shows a screen title when everyone has leaped to you.
Leap Counter.leap counter: Counts how many teammates leap to you in F7/M7 Phase 3 and alerts when all have arrived.
Leap Counter.leap hud: Shows the leap count on screen while you are on a countable section.
Leap Counter.leap radius: How close to you, in blocks, a teammate must land to count (1-8).
Leap Counter.relic leaps: Teammates expected to leap to you in Phase 5. 0 turns it off.
Leap Counter.s1 leaps: Teammates expected to leap to you in section 1. 0 turns it off.
Leap Counter.s2 leaps: Teammates expected to leap to you in section 2. 0 turns it off.
Leap Counter.s3 leaps: Teammates expected to leap to you in section 3. 0 turns it off.
Leap Counter.s4 leaps: Teammates expected to leap to you in section 4. 0 turns it off.
Leap Counter.show at zero: Shows the count at 0 before the first teammate has leaped to you.

Loadout Keybinds.loadout keybinds: Lets keys click loadout slots and change pages on the Loadout screen.

Maxor's Crystals.active crystal counter: Shows how many of the five crystals are currently active.
Maxor's Crystals.filled boxes: Also fills the crystal boxes instead of drawing only the outline.
Maxor's Crystals.highlight crystals: Boxes the real crystals in the arena.
Maxor's Crystals.place timer: Times how long you take to place a crystal and remembers your best.
Maxor's Crystals.reset best place time: Shows your fastest crystal placement. Click twice to reset it.
Maxor's Crystals.respawn timer: Shows a countdown to the next crystal spawning.
Maxor's Crystals.unplaced crystal alert: Warns you while you are carrying a crystal you have not placed.

Mod Chat.mod chat: A private chat with other mod users; send with /killer560 chat <message>.

Name Changer.name changer: Changes how player names look on your screen, client-side only.

Nickhider.randomize others: Gives every other player a fake name for this session; works without the Name Changer toggle.

P3 Nav.color: Colour of the boxes on this row.
P3 Nav.current section only: ON only boxes your current section; OFF boxes everything left in Phase 3.
P3 Nav.device highlight: Outlines P3 devices you have not done yet.
P3 Nav.gate highlight: Boxes the Phase 3 gate you're heading for.
P3 Nav.gate line width: Thickness of the gate box outline.
P3 Nav.gate style: Outline, Fill, or both, for the gate box.
P3 Nav.hide once destroyed: ON hides the gate box once the gate is broken; OFF keeps it drawn.
P3 Nav.highlight style: How the highlight is drawn: outline, filled, or both.
P3 Nav.terminal highlight: Outlines P3 terminals you have not done yet.

P4 Platform Highlight.p4 platform highlight: F7/M7 only: boxes the platform you mine through to reach Necron.

Party Commands.party commands: Turns on the Party Commands tab; each command still needs its own toggle.

Party Interop.cross-mod bridge: Shares dungeon data both ways with users of Devonian, NoammAddons and Odin.
Party Interop.local mod bridge: Reads dungeon info from NoammAddons and Odin if you have them installed.
Party Interop.log pickups: Prints each piece of party info into chat as it is picked up.
Party Interop.party interop: Shares and receives dungeon run info with your party; turn off to stop both.
Party Interop.read party chat: Reads the announcements other dungeon mods make in party chat.
Party Interop.share dungeon data with party: Shares your dungeon info (rooms, secrets, mimic, dragons) with your party over the mod relay.
Party Interop.use mod relay: Accepts dungeon info from other players running this mod.
Party Interop.work it out myself: Works out dungeon run info on its own from what Hypixel already sends you.

Performance HUD.performance hud: Shows TPS, ping, FPS and a click counter in one movable HUD element.

Pet Wheel.pet wheel: Turns on the Pet Wheel for quickly summoning pets.

Profile Viewer.clear: Deletes the saved Hypixel API key.
Profile Viewer.hypixel api key: Optional. Paste your own Hypixel API key for faster lookups.
Profile Viewer.open key: Key that opens this feature's screen.
Profile Viewer.open my profile: Opens the profile viewer on your own Skyblock profile.
Profile Viewer.remember last page: Reopens the profile viewer on the page you last used.
Profile Viewer.show skin: Shows the player's 3D skin on the profile viewer's main page.
Profile Viewer.source: Where profile data comes from: your Hypixel API key, SkyBlockPV, or Auto.

Quiver Display.quiver display: Shows how many arrows you have left in a HUD line.

Rag Axe.rag axe: Ragnarock Axe helper with cast detection, timers and rag now prompts.

Revert Master Stars.revert master stars: Turns the Master Star number on item names back into that many red stars.

Run Stats.run stats: Prints a per-player summary in chat after each dungeon run: rooms cleared, secrets and deaths.

Run Summary.run summary: Records a summary of each finished dungeon run (splits, secrets, deaths, score) that you can reopen later.

Score Calculator.score calculator: Shows a live estimate of your dungeon score on a movable HUD.

Scrollable Tooltips.scrollable tooltips: Lets the mouse wheel scroll or nudge an item tooltip in inventories and menus.

Secrets HUD.secrets hud: Shows the secrets found in your current dungeon room over its total, as a small movable HUD.

Sharp Shooter (i4).aim marker color: Colour of the i4 Solver's aim dots.
Sharp Shooter (i4).solver: Highlights the i4 targets you still need to hit and draws dots showing where to aim.

Sim Settings.echoes of the lost: Dungeon Sim only: Dungeon Breaker charges each secret gives back. This is the Wither Essence Shop perk Echoes of the Lost (levels 1-5 restore 1-5 charges); 0 is off. Defaults to the maxed perk. The breaker still holds 20 and regenerates 2 a second.

Slot Binds.slot binds: Links two inventory slots so shift-clicking one swaps them.

Split Timers.split timers: Shows a HUD timing each part of a dungeon run.

Spring Boots.spring boots overlay: Shows how many blocks high your Spring Boots jump is charged to.

Starred Mob Hitboxes.bats: Highlights secret bats during dungeon clear.
Starred Mob Hitboxes.color: Colour of the boxes or glow for this row's target.
Starred Mob Hitboxes.line width: Thickness of the drawn lines and box outlines.
Starred Mob Hitboxes.range: How far away a starred mob or bat can be, in blocks, and still be boxed.
Starred Mob Hitboxes.room scoped: Boxes every starred mob and bat in the room you are in, however far away.
Starred Mob Hitboxes.starred mob hitboxes: Boxes starred mobs and secret bats, and highlights the F7/M7 wither boss.
Starred Mob Hitboxes.starred mobs: Highlights starred mobs and minibosses during dungeon clear.
Starred Mob Hitboxes.style: How starred mobs and bats are highlighted: Outline Box, Filled Box, or Glow.
Starred Mob Hitboxes.wither highlight: Highlights the F7/M7 wither bosses at any range while you can see them.
Starred Mob Hitboxes.wither style: Picks how the wither highlight is drawn: Glow Hitbox or Hitbox Fill.

Storage Search.storage search: Run /search to find items across all your cached storages, chests and menus.

Team Melody.team melody hud: Shows each teammate's Melody terminal progress during Phase 3.

Teammate Highlight.teammate highlight: Draws a box around each party member, coloured by their dungeon class.

Terminal Timers.terminal timers: Shows terminal solve times and section splits in your own chat during F7/M7 P3.

Terracotta Timer.terracotta timer: Shows a respawn countdown over each broken terracotta in the F6/M6 boss.

Thorn (F4).add stun spot here: Saves a stun spot on the block you're standing on.
Thorn (F4).overkill chat: Posts each Spirit Bear's overkill count in chat when its ring resets.
Thorn (F4).overkill to party: Also sends each Spirit Bear's overkill count to party chat (/pc).
Thorn (F4).remove last stun spot: Deletes the most recently added stun spot.
Thorn (F4).show overkill: Adds an Overkill line under the Spirit Bear HUD for wasted spirit kills.
Thorn (F4).spirit bear color: Opens a color picker for the Spirit Bear highlight.
Thorn (F4).spirit bear counter: Shows how many Spirit Bears are left on your HUD.
Thorn (F4).spirit bear highlight: Highlights the Spirit Bear during the Thorn fight.
Thorn (F4).spirit bear hud: Shows Spirit Bear kills and a spawn countdown in F4/M4.
Thorn (F4).spirit bow color: Opens a color picker for the Spirit Bow highlight.
Thorn (F4).spirit bow highlight: Highlights the Spirit Bow that drops when the Spirit Bear dies.
Thorn (F4).spirit mob color: Opens a color picker for the spirit mob highlight.
Thorn (F4).spirit mob highlight: Highlights the spirit animals in the Thorn fight.
Thorn (F4).stun spot color: Opens a color picker for stun-spot waypoints.
Thorn (F4).stun spot labels: Shows each stun spot's name above its box.
Thorn (F4).stun spot waypoints: Draws your saved stun spot waypoints during the F4/M4 boss.
Thorn (F4).stun spots: Shows saved spots in the world where you stand to stun Thorn.
Thorn (F4).thorn color: Opens a color picker for the Thorn highlight.
Thorn (F4).thorn esp line width: Outline thickness for the Thorn highlight boxes, 1-10.
Thorn (F4).thorn esp style: How Thorn highlights are drawn: Outline Box, Filled Box or Glow; click to cycle.
Thorn (F4).thorn highlight: Highlights Thorn during the F4/M4 fight.
Thorn (F4).thorn highlights: Coloured boxes or a glow on Thorn-fight targets during the F4/M4 boss.

Tick Timers.tick timers: Shows a countdown HUD for the F7/M7 boss phases.

Trail.trail: Draws a cosmetic trail of squares at your feet as you move.

Trajectories.trajectories: Draws the flight path and landing spot of your bow shot or Ender Pearl.

Waypoint Routes.waypoint routes: Shows ordered waypoint routes for the current Skyblock area.
